panels.headline: For you
panels.body: Your support keeps independent work personal, human, and close to home.
panels.art_direction: Cinematic single-object cover with warm citrus and cream palette, deep teal accents, and soft gold ornamentation. A clean lower text-safe area for app-rendered headline and body.
